methods.name: getValidatorStates
methods.desc: Each validator's current state, in order. `@ghostkit-chunk validatorIds refsPerItem=1 maxPerGroup=127`

methods.name: getBlockTimestamps
methods.desc: Timestamps of the `num` blocks before the first valid round, oldest first.

methods.name: getRoundTimestamp
methods.desc:
The simulated round's block timestamp. Ghostkit sets first and last valid to one past the simulated round, so
that round is `Txn.firstValid - 1`. Unpinned, it's the newest block the call can read, near the latest round.

methods.name: firstRoundAtOrAfter
methods.desc:
The first round from `start` up to the simulated round whose block timestamp is at or after `target`, with that
timestamp; `[0, 0]` if there is none. `start` must be within the 1,000 rounds before the simulated round that a
program can read.

methods.name: getAlgodVersion

methods.name: getAssets
methods.desc: Each asset's params; a zero creator if the asset doesn't exist. `@ghostkit-chunk assetIds refsPerItem=1`

methods.name: getPoolBalancesAndLastPayouts

methods.name: getPoolStates

methods.name: getStakerPositions

methods.name: getAccountBalances
methods.desc: Each account's balance and minimum balance, in order. Zero for accounts that don't exist. `@ghostkit-chunk accounts refsPerItem=1`

methods.name: getAssetHoldings
